roles.title: AI Engineer
highlights: Delivered a Cisco Webex provisioning automation solution using Azure Logic Apps, Python, FastAPI, and PostgreSQL, integrating Webex with Salesforce and internal systems to cut provisioning and hardware-ordering turnaround from hours to minutes.
Extended the Webex solution for larger, more complex enterprise customers using an agentic AI-powered harness to streamline solution design, development, testing, and delivery across the SDLC.

Delivered an AI-powered call summarisation solution using Generative AI, Azure Logic Apps, and Cosmos DB, generating near-real-time customer interaction summaries that reduced manual documentation and Average Handle Time (AHT).

Built an Agentic AI call-flow generation solution (React/TypeScript frontend, Python backend) integrating with Salesforce to translate customer requirements into AI-generated call-flow designs, cutting provisioning turnaround from 10+ days to ~2 days.

Delivered CRM-integrated toll-free service automation, streamlining order submission and billing processes while reducing manual errors and effort.
